## Summary

- Prepare core and all three Apple Flutter runtime companions at
`0.20.3` for #2099. The companion bumps ship updated installation
examples. Their core constraints and SwiftPM pins are identical to
`0.20.2`.
- Regenerate the chat app, validation harness, and observability
lockfiles. Only local package versions changed.
- Promote the Qwen3-ASR and Gemma 4 fixes and the speech guide
correction in both core changelogs. The docs changelog retains the
`0.20.x` and `0.19.x` series. The root changelog is 158,846 bytes.
